extra_setup: HF token must exist at $HF_CACHE/token; start.sh runs `hf download ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-NVFP4` on the host; mounts $HF_CACHE -> /root/.cache/huggingface and $HOME/.cache/vllm -> /root/.cache/vllm; bind-mounts two b12x patches read-only: patches/kernel.py -> /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/b12x/moe/_shared/kernels/w4a16/kernel.py and patches/route_pack.py -> .../w4a16/route_pack.py (fix MTP + CUDA graph capture crash).
notes: Args passed after the image as a command (`vllm serve ...`). MODEL_IN_CONTAINER = HF cache snapshot path under /root/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--ornith-ai--Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-NVFP4/snapshots/<sha>. HOST defaults to 127.0.0.1 in start.sh (local only), PORT 8888. GPU_UTIL is computed at launch: min(0.85, 0.95 x free/total device memory), floor 0.2 (README KV numbers measured at 0.83). HF_TOKEN is exported on the host but not passed into the container. Image tag is :latest (unpinned).
